column1: # This is a CANopen config template for building P4 config files
RPDO1 Receive type (APPLY ON EVERY SYNC)
RPDO2 Receive type (APPLY ON EVERY SYNC)
Motor temp limit in deg C to 85 (deg C)
Revision Number (bits 0-15: minor rev; bits 16-31: major rev)
Motor L_hf (uH) (0 = off; isense ripple correction)
Resistance of Thermistor at baseline Temperature (Ohms)
PWM periods per case slot (0 = auto)
